Pes. 76ᵇ מפטמי מהדדי they are fattened (or flavored) with one another.

senses.gloss: to flavor one’s words (cmp. בְּסַם), to console, cheer up.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 66a:1">B. Mets. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>פַּטּוּמֵי מילי בעלמא הוא</he> it was merely meant to cheer up (the neighbor, not as a binding promise).
